title: Exit codes: 0, 1, 2 and 3 in one place
description: pkg has one ballerina:1 issue and a file named blocked; not-a-project has no Ballerina.toml; invalid-scan-toml has one error in each of [rule], [gate], [analysis] and [[analyzer]]. Each note gives the expected exit code. Errors print 'bal scan: error: <message>', followed by '<file>:<line>:<col>: error: <message>' lines for Scan.toml; warnings never change the exit code. On Windows, bal.bat exits 0 whatever the scan returns, so check the printed error there. Not available before 0.13.0. Exit code 130 (Ctrl+C) has to be checked by hand.

steps.name: Success
steps.note: 0: issues alone never fail the scan.

steps.name: Report write failure
steps.note: 1: blocked is a file, so the report cannot be written.

steps.name: Invalid Scan.toml
steps.note: 1: all four errors at once, each with its line and column; nothing is scanned.
